_doc: Priorities from client-usage.md table surfaces; unused=skip. Done means covered by real Connection tests. Partial notes list known limits.

assets.createUrl.note: Tested: attachment, workspace-file (incl. HTML dependency grants), media-file (identity-pinned), draft-workspace-file, project-favicon (+missing sentinel). GET /api/assets/* streams, supports Range/HEAD, rejects traversal/forged/expired tokens. tool-output-image is implemented but untested; native-app-icon and github-media are refused; mcp-app HTML injection not done.

assets.persistChatAttachments.note: No client call site in inventory.

attachments.createUploadUrl.note: Real-client test (files_assets): HMAC-signed 10 min grant, type/size limits (10 MiB image, 50 MiB file), pending-<uuid>[-ext] ids. Token layout matches T3.

attachments.delete.note: Real-client test: removes pending uploads (and .txt sidecar), idempotent, ignores non-pending or malformed ids. Upload route: streamed to a .part file, exact size, 204, 409 on conflicting duplicate.

cloud.getRelayClientStatus.note: No client call site in inventory.

cloud.installRelayClient.note: No client call site in inventory.

device.shutdown.note: No client call site in inventory.

filesystem.browse.note: Real-client test: prefix filter, hidden folders, explicit-relative paths need cwd, Windows paths refused, unreadable dir error.

filesystem.getMetadata.note: Real-client test: file/directory/null, header MIME sniff for extensionless files, batch limit of 64.

git.resolvePullRequest.note: No client call site in inventory.

git.runStackedAction.note: Real-client stream test: commit, commit_push, push, commit_push_pr (with gh), featureBranch, filePaths subset, up-to-date and no-change results, action_failed with the failing phase, request validation, path confinement. Not done: hook_* events, generated commit messages, cancellation of a running step (an Interrupt stops sending events but the step finishes), PR creation without gh.

mcpApps.toolInfo.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.dispatchCommand.note: Remaining: native attachment steering, full attempt/provider-thread identity, background/subagent settlement, active execution recovery and native delivery acknowledgement. Persistent exact-operation consent and both native plan acceptance flows have real-client peer coverage; broad native permission rules/revocation UI remain unsupported.

orchestration.getArchivedShellSnapshot.note: Real-client test: archived threads and projects with the shared sequence. Built from the in-memory shell assembly (10,000 thread cap), same limit as the live shell.

orchestration.getFullThreadDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures Git refs and verifies baseline-to-turn diff. Checkpoint retention and overlapping-workspace isolation remain.

orchestration.getThreadFamily.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.getThreadProjection.note: Real-client test: bounded projection (up to 100 rows per kind) and an error for unknown threads.

orchestration.getTurnDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures baseline/end refs using a private Git index; test verifies diff over a real workspace change. Includes untracked nonignored files and deletions; non-Git workspaces report unavailable.

orchestration.getTurnItem.note: Real-client test: item by id for its own thread, null otherwise. The revision argument is ignored.

orchestration.getWorktreeThreadIds.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.launchThread.note: Remaining: worktree preparation failure cleanup and reused-thread metadata parity. Thread, first message/context, run, events and receipt are transaction-atomic; provider starts after commit (tests/provider_input.rs).

orchestration.searchThread.note: Real Connection + isolated nightly 3991 differential: literal transcript message/plan search, case folding, index/start/offset, wrap and bounded navigation implemented. tests/thread_commands.rs verifies ordering and isolation. Rich markdown/context/skills segmentation and folded-answer exclusion remain; not full conformance.

orchestration.searchThreadStream.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.searchThreads.note: Real-client test: SQLite FTS5 index kept by message writes and rebuilt when missing; best message per thread with hits/quality/snippet, prefix match, project filter, titlesOnly, archived/deleted excluded, FTS syntax inert. Not done: threads/olderSettled fields, environmentLabel.

orchestration.subscribeArchivedShell.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.subscribeCommandOutput.note: Real Connection tests verify bounded command tails/replacement/final output. Real Claude Bash results and Codex command/outputDelta frames emit Command events. Claude output arrives at tool completion; no full VT folding.

orchestration.subscribeShell.note: Remaining: repository identity replacement metadata and full shell metadata/ordering parity. Latest user/run timestamps are implemented. Retained field consumers: P0-FIELD-AUDIT.md; bounded stream evidence does not certify all interleavings.

orchestration.subscribeThread.note: Remaining: full attempt/provider-thread identity and upstream ordering parity. Background/subagent recovery and native lifecycle parity remain incomplete. Structured questions, both proposed-plan flows and source-plan completion have real-client peer coverage; restart finalizes streaming messages, tool items and orphan nodes.

projects.listEntries.note: No client call site in inventory.

projects.mutate.note: Tested over RPC and POST /api/projects/mutate: create/update/delete, idempotent replay, workspace-root validation (exists, createWorkspaceRootIfMissing, no duplicate roots), delete needs force when threads exist, shell events project.updated/removed on the shared sequence, scope checks. Not done: repositoryIdentity, force-delete does not cascade to threads. Differential fix: creation initializes optional null/default metadata (including repositoryIdentity); simple project.create shape matches nightly 3991.

projects.readFile.note: Real-client test: relative paths rooted lexically and by realpath (symlink escapes refused), 1 MiB cap with truncated flag, binary refused, allowMissing, absolute host paths read in place as T3 does, filesystem:read scope.

projects.searchContents.note: No client call site in inventory.

projects.searchEntries.note: Real-client test: git ignore rules, kind/imageOnly filters, limit clamp, truncated flag, missing root error. Ranking is o3's own (basename, then path, then subsequence), not T3's fff finder; index capped at 25,000 entries.

review.getDiffFileContents.note: Real-client test: old/new contents for working-tree and branch-range, new/deleted, escapes, symlinks and binary files refused, known-workspace check.

review.getDiffPreview.note: Real-client test: working-tree and branch-range sources with untracked files (throwaway index), single-file and ignoreWhitespace requests, 120 kB truncation, non-repo yields no sources, cwd must be a known workspace.

scheduledTasks.runNow.note: tests/ops.rs: launches a thread or messages one; the in-process timer fires due tasks. "succeeded" means launched, not that the agent finished.

scheduledTasks.subscribe.note: No client call site in inventory.

scheduledTasks.upsert.note: tests/ops.rs: interval and fixed_time (UTC) schedules, commandId idempotency, requireExisting. Webhook schedules are refused.

secrets.answerRequest.note: tests/ops.rs: save/decline of secret_request items, value in a 0600 file only, typed failures. No adapter consumes the file yet.

server.discoverSourceControl.note: Real Connection + nightly differential: bounded git/jj executable/version probes, Effect Option encoding, honest implementation flags. Host-provider discovery/auth adapters are absent (sourceControlProviders=[]); upstream includes GitHub/GitLab descriptors. See docs/CONFORMANCE.md.

server.getBackgroundPolicy.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.getConfig.note: Remaining: startup command/skill discovery, custom instances, settings normalization and proactive quota refresh. Claude pinned models/options, post-init commands/skills and observed native quota windows are implemented; Codex usage windows update from native notifications. No fabricated startup quota values.

server.getDatabaseStorage.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.getProcessDiagnostics.note: tests/ops.rs: the server process tree from /proc, with Option encoding for pgid/error.

server.getProcessResourceHistory.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.getResourceTelemetryHistory.note: tests/ops.rs: buckets from a 10 s sampler that starts at the first call; per-process IO and the desktop source are not available.

server.getSettings.note: Connection test: persisted settings, unknown fields and secret sentinel round-trip.

server.getStorageCleanupReport.note: tests/ops.rs: stream of the latest manual report (null before any); no automatic runs.

server.getTraceDiagnostics.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.getUsageSummary.note: tests/ops.rs: always empty (contractVersion 6, pricing unavailable); o3-server reads no usage ledgers.

server.reportClientActivity.note: tests/ops.rs: validated, kept per client until its ttl; nothing consumes it yet (no background policy).

server.setAcpRegistryProvider.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.uninstallAcpRegistryManagedBinary.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.updateServerWithProgress.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.updateSettings.note: Connection tests: provider instance create/upsert/remove, redacted environment preservation, entry replacement/null removal, directory history, primitive type checks. Full upstream normalization/model preferences/background policy remain.

shell.openInEditor.note: Real-client test with a fake editor on PATH: argv launch without a shell, unknown editor and option-like cwd refused, missing editor fails. Opens the folder only: goto/line-column styles and file-manager reveal are not implemented.

subscribeServerConfig.note: Connection test: initial config snapshot; changes emit replacement snapshots rather than typed incremental config events. Also accepts server.subscribeServerConfig alias used by client inventory.

subscribeServerLifecycle.note: No client call site in inventory.

subscribeTerminalEvents.note: tests/terminal.rs: manager-wide events from a bounded ring; a subscriber that falls behind the ring is ended.

subscribeTerminalMetadata.note: tests/terminal.rs: snapshot, upserts incl. hasRunningSubprocess/label from /proc, remove on close.

subscribeVcsStatus.note: No client call site in inventory.

terminal.attach.note: tests/terminal.rs: snapshot then live tail without loss/duplication, resume, restartIfNotRunning, 8-chunk/64 KiB window. Same gaps as terminal.open. Differential fix: snapshots include current cols/rows; nightly 3991 simple open/attach shapes match.

terminal.clear.note: tests/terminal.rs: cleared event and empty history.

terminal.close.note: tests/terminal.rs: kills the process group (HUP, TERM, KILL after 1 s), emits closed, resume attach reports closed.

terminal.observe.note: tests/terminal.rs: read-only snapshot + tail with terminal:read; a lagging subscriber is resynchronised with a snapshot.

terminal.open.note: tests/terminal.rs. Real PTY, process group, bounded scrollback. providerInstanceId environment is not applied; history is not persisted across a server restart. Differential fix: snapshots include current cols/rows; nightly 3991 simple open/attach shapes match.

terminal.resize.note: tests/terminal.rs: stty reports the new size.

terminal.restart.note: tests/terminal.rs: new pid, restarted event, fresh history. providerInstanceId environment is not applied.

terminal.write.note: tests/terminal.rs: data reaches the shell; typed lookup and not-running errors; exited terminals accept writes silently.

vcs.createRef.note: Real-client test: create, switchRef, duplicate refused with branch_already_exists, hostile names refused, concurrent creates serialized per repository.

vcs.createWorktree.note: No client call site in inventory.

vcs.init.note: Real-client test: git init (also on an existing repo); jj is refused as unsupported; missing cwd is an error.

vcs.listRefs.note: Real-client test: current/default first, local and remote refs, worktreePath, pagination (cursor/limit/nextCursor), query, refKind, matching-remote dedupe. The refresh flag is ignored (no cache).

vcs.pull.note: Real-client test: fast-forward pulled, up-to-date skipped, no upstream and diverged history are errors; --ff-only, never merges.

vcs.refreshStatus.note: Real-client test: non-repo, clean, dirty (modified/staged/untracked line counts), upstream ahead/behind, branchChanges vs default branch, aheadOfDefaultCount. pr is always null and sourceControlProvider is absent (no host adapter); localOnly ignored. Differential fix: aheadOfDefaultCount and zero branchChanges defaults are present even without a default/remote ref.

vcs.removeWorktree.note: No client call site in inventory.

vcs.switchRef.note: Real-client test: local switch, remote-only ref becomes a tracking branch, unknown ref refused.

checkpoint.rollback.note: Real Connection execution captures real refs and restores baseline workspace files. Private-index test covers additions/deletions and preserves user index. Refuses active runs; provider conversation rewind and crash-safe restore replay remain.

message.dispatch.note: Remaining: attachment steering, complete attempt identity and active execution recovery. Native uploaded images/files and serialized context are implemented; receipt-atomic control outbox records uncertain handoffs without blind replay.

queue.resume.note: tests/thread_commands.rs: also covers run.interrupt holdQueue and automatic advance when a run ends.

queued-message.promote-to-steer.note: Real Connection Codex-peer test promotes queuedRunId into targetRunId using the native steer control, cancels the queued run and reassigns its message; rejects inactive/cross-thread targets and attachments.

queued-run.reorder.note: tests/thread_commands.rs: user messages only; automatic completion deliveries are not modelled.

run.interrupt.note: Remaining: native acknowledgement/replay after crash. Receipt-atomic control outbox persists uncertain delivery and restart reports delivery-unknown; live native control covered by Codex peer.

runtime-request.respond.note: Remaining: broad native approval rules and policy revocation UI; native response acknowledgement/replay after restart. acceptAlways persists exact operation consent scoped to thread/provider/worktree/project; changed operations, questions and mode changes require new consent. Structured questions and Claude plan capture/deny plus later implementation are implemented.

subagent.stop.note: tests/thread_commands.rs: marks the subagent cancelled; no provider session is told.

thread.auto-settle.note: No client call site in inventory.

thread.auto-settle.set.note: Real-client opt-out command coverage; conservative periodic idle settlement respects project/global age, pins, explicit active override and pending runs/requests/subagents/uncertain controls. PR-linked threads are retained; merge-triggered settlement remains unsupported.

thread.created.record.note: No client call site in inventory.

thread.fork.note: tests/thread_commands.rs: new linked thread, inherited history rows copied in SQLite, idempotent. Native provider-thread fork/handoff is not performed.

thread.merge_back.note: No client call site in inventory.

thread.metadata.update.note: Real-client lifecycle and plan E2E: title regeneration derives a bounded deterministic title from first user message; explicit title still wins. Provider-generated semantic titles are not implemented.

thread.model-selection.set.note: tests/thread_commands.rs: updates selection and switches provider instance; no provider-session handoff.

thread.pull-request.sync.note: tests/thread_commands.rs: staleness checks and branch PR update; no discovery performed here.

thread.pull-request.watch.note: tests/thread_commands.rs: metadata only; nothing wakes the thread on PR changes.

thread.stop.note: No client call site in inventory.

thread.title.regeneration.complete.note: No client call site in inventory.

thread.user-input.dismiss.note: Real Connection scripted provider test; production delivery/recovery not complete.
